name: extract-c
cmd:
set -o pipefail; ( bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && . research/langs/c/clang-setup.sh && cd core && bun test extract-c.test.ts 2>&1 ) 2>&1 | tee "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/native.log"; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; printf '{"exitCode":%s}
' "$rc" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/COMMAND-RESULT.json"; exit "$rc"

name: extract-jvm
cmd:
set -o pipefail; ( bun install --frozen-lockfile > /tmp/bun-install.log 2>&1 || { echo bun install failed; tail -20 /tmp/bun-install.log; exit 1; }; . research/langs/jvm/jvm-setup.sh && cd core && bun test extract-jvm.test.ts 2>&1 ) 2>&1 | tee "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/native.log"; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; printf '{"exitCode":%s}
' "$rc" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/COMMAND-RESULT.json"; exit "$rc"

name: runner-cli-c-jvm
cmd:
set -o pipefail; ( bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && clang --version | head -1 && javac -version 2>&1 && cd core && bun test --timeout 300000 exports.test.ts cli.test.ts extract-c.test.ts extract-jvm.test.ts 2>&1 ) 2>&1 | tee "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/native.log"; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; printf '{"exitCode":%s}
' "$rc" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/COMMAND-RESULT.json"; exit "$rc"

name: fixtures-c-jvm-lint
cmd:
set -o pipefail; ( bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && bunx oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config core/extract-c.test.ts core/extract-jvm.test.ts core/extract-c.ts core/extract-go-check.ts core/extract-go.ts core/laws.ts core/extract.ts research/bapa/0503-fixtures-c-jvm/law-bindings.test.ts ) 2>&1 | tee "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/native.log"; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; printf '{"exitCode":%s}
' "$rc" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/COMMAND-RESULT.json"; exit "$rc"

name: fixtures-c-jvm-lowering
cmd: set -o pipefail; ( bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun test research/bapa/0503-fixtures-c-jvm/law-bindings.test.ts ) 2>&1 | tee "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/native.log"; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; printf '{"exitCode":%s}\n' "$rc" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/COMMAND-RESULT.json"; exit "$rc"
